newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends unchanged at intra-day low vs US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends unchanged at intra-day low vs US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed unchanged at an intra-day low of 8.3000 in dull trading on Thursday, with little impact seen from comments by the governor of the central bank on money policy in 1997, traders said.
Official newspapers on Thursday quoted Dai Xianglong as saying China would continue an appropriately tight money policy in 1997, but that this did not mean the central bank would reduce money supply.
The yuan opened slightly higher at 8.2995 and consolidated above 8.3000 for most of the session, hitting an intra-day high of 8.2991 before closing at a low.
Trading was dull, with most done at 8.2995, traders said.

"Dai's comments had no direct impact on the yuan's exchange rate," one dealer said. "But his remarks suggest that the supply of yuan will increase slowly next year, which will depress the yuan in the market."
Dealers expect the yuan to move around 8.3000 for the rest of the year.
The yuan closed down slightly at 7.3412 from 7.3200 against 100 Japanese yen and up at an intra-day high of 1.0725 from 1.0737 against the Hong Kong dollar.
